## Before submitting

- Search existing issues for the same problem.
- For a security vulnerability, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Eeshan-Vaghjiani/Spendly/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
  Do not disclose sensitive details here.
- **Do not include private financial information**, transaction/SMS exports,
  personal identifiers, passwords, tokens, database URLs, or signing keys.
  Use synthetic accounts and records; inspect logs and screenshots before attaching.
